Subject: Next step: 30-minute product intro + stakeholder alignment

Hi Jamie / Olivia,

Thanks again for taking time to walk through ClearAudio's evaluation goals today — really helpful to hear about the production latency spikes during batch exports and the need for tighter audit logging for compliance. Quick recap on what we heard:

- Primary goal: reduce downstream inference cost per unit while keeping p95 latency under 150ms for your streaming pipelines.
- Secondary: private deployment options (VPC), SSO integration (SAML), and exportable audit logs for quarterly audits.

We recommend a 30-minute product intro where we can: 1) run a short live walk-through tailored to your streaming pattern, 2) share measured latency/cost profiles from similar customers, and 3) confirm stakeholders and next steps for a short pilot.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PT):
- Mon Aug 24 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Aug 25 — 10:30–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 26 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Who from your side should join? Based on the discussion, I suggest: tech owner (platform/infra), one product manager, and procurement for a quick timeline check. From our side I'll bring Marissa (solutions engineering) and Olga (customer lead) so we can run the live example and answer any security/compliance questions.

I've attached a short 6-slide deck with what we plan to cover — feel free to share internally. If none of the slots work, tell me two windows that do and we'll match.

Next steps: pick one slot, confirm attendees, and we'll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Best,

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
